Lindsey Vonn has been recuperating for months from a terrifying crash at the 2026 Winter Olympics that nearly cost her a leg.

The Olympian, who came out of a six-year retirement to compete in February 2026, was airlifted off a downhill course in Italy and flown home for a cascade of surgeries.

Scroll below for everything Vonn has said about her recovery:

A Timeline of Lindsey Vonn's Olympic Injury and Near-Amputation 

What Happened at the 2026 Winter Olympics? 
 Vonn crashed roughly 13 seconds into her women’s downhill run on February 8, 2026, suffering a complex fracture of her left tibia. She had entered the race already injured, having torn her ACL nine days earlier during a World Cup race in Switzerland.

Vonn later wrote via Instagram that she was “simply 5 inches too tight on my line when my right arm hooked inside of the gate,” adding that her ACL and past injuries “had nothing to do with [her] crash whatsoever.”

She was airlifted off the course and taken to Ca’ Foncello hospital for her initial orthopedic operation.

A Fasciotomy Saved Lindsey Vonn’s Leg 
 Vonn underwent four surgeries in Italy before being flown back to the United States on February 17, 2026, for several more operations. Days after returning home, she posted an X-ray of her leg reinforced with plates and screws alongside the caption, “I’m bionic for real now.”

items.title: The Bachelor’s Kelley Flanagan Explains Why She Hasn’t Dated in 2 Years
items.summary:
The Bachelor alum Kelley Flanagan hit pause on her dating life two years ago — and she hasn’t looked back.

“I haven’t been on a date in almost two years, and let me take you back to what was going on in my life two years ago,” Flanagan, 34, began in a Sunday, November 22, Instagram video .

“I was dating a guy who I found out was cheating on me, and then about a month later, my dad passed away,” she recalled. “There have only been two times in my life where I felt like I was not at a good place mentally. One was after The Bachelor , and the second was after losing my dad.”

Flanagan added that the death of her father was “one of the hardest things” she has ever experienced.

Peter Weber and Kelley Flanagan's Complete Relationship Timeline 

“For months, I just felt like I was surviving,” she admitted. “Wake up, do what you need to get done, go to bed. That was my life for months, and eventually my friends started asking me, ‘Are you seeing anyone? Are you going to start dating again?’ And I just didn’t have the mental capacity to do it.”

Flanagan continued, “I didn’t want to meet new people. I didn’t want to put myself in new environments. I just wanted to stay in my own little comfort zone, and I remember thinking that my glass was already so full that even the smallest thing could make it overflow. And I just knew I needed to get myself back to a place where I just felt OK again.”

Flanagan said she considered “three things that genuinely make me happy” to break free of her rut.

“Astrology, interior design and gardening. So that’s what I started doing,” she explained.…
